statements.text: Assessment: right lumbar radiculopathy at L4-L5 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
MRI lumbar spine 08/21/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Baseline ODI prior to any intervention: 59%.
Reports low back pain radiating to the right leg for 16 weeks.
PT discharge summary: completed 7 weeks of physical therapy (05/25/2026 to 07/13/2026) without meaningful improvement; ibuprofen 600 mg TID for the same period without relief.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
No red flags: afebrile, no unexplained weight loss, no history of malignancy, no saddle anesthesia.
